lineage: Ransomware-as-a-service widely reported as an offshoot of Conti
summary: BlackByte is a RaaS operation active since mid-2021 that has hit US critical infrastructure. Early intrusions exploited ProxyShell/ProxyLogon on Exchange and planted ASPX web shells; in 2024 Talos saw entry with valid, likely brute-forced, VPN credentials and abuse of the ESXi 'ESX Admins' authentication bypass (CVE-2024-37085) days after disclosure. The group stands out for its bring-your-own-vulnerable-driver EDR blinding (RTCore64.sys, DBUtil_2_3.sys, zamguard64.sys, gdrv.sys) and its custom ExByte exfiltration tool that uploads to MEGA. Its wormable encryptor spreads with embedded domain credentials, and Talos assesses that only 20–30% of victims ever appear on its leak site.
uniqueTraits: BYOVD EDR blinding: RTCore64.sys (CVE-2019-16098) loaded as service RABAsSaa to zero kernel callbacks; 2024 builds drop four drivers (RtCore64, DBUtil_2_3, zamguard64, gdrv)
Exploited CVE-2024-37085 by creating the AD group 'ESX Admins' within days of disclosure
ExByte: Go-based exfiltration tool that uploads to MEGA using an obfuscated data.txt credential file
Signature registry changes: LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy=1, EnableLinkedConnections=1 and LongPathsEnabled, plus a Defender '*.exe' extension exclusion
vssadmin resize shadowstorage 401MB, then UNBOUNDED; wordpad /p print-bombing of the ransom note; wormable SMB/PsExec self-propagation with hard-coded credentials

chain.procedure: Exploits ProxyShell (CVE-2021-34473, CVE-2021-34523, CVE-2021-31207) and ProxyLogon on internet-facing Exchange. It then forges an Exchange PowerShell backend token to impersonate domain admins.
chain.noAtomicReason: No local atomic exploits Exchange ProxyShell or ProxyLogon. Validate with IIS/Exchange logs (autodiscover SSRF patterns) and with the follow-on web-shell step.

chain.procedure: 2024: logs in to the VPN with a valid account that has a basic naming convention and a weak password, likely brute-forced through internet scanning, and the VPN does not enforce MFA.
chain.noAtomicReason: Brute force against the VPN appliance happens at the perimeter, and there is no endpoint atomic for it. Validate with VPN authentication-failure and success-after-failure analytics instead.

chain.procedure: Uses New-MailboxExportRequest to write ASPX web shells under the Exchange OWA auth directories, and uses them to drop Cobalt Strike.

atomics.note: Writes a web shell into a web-server directory. It exercises the file-write detection that the Exchange web-shell drop triggers.

chain.procedure: Downloads a Cobalt Strike beacon (sys.exe) from public file-sharing sites such as temp[.]sh.

atomics.note: Downloads a file with PowerShell.
Downloads a file with curl.

chain.techniqueName: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys
chain.procedure: Creates an HKCU Run value named 'MsEdgeMsE' that loads the api-msvc.dll backdoor through rundll32 from Downloads, C:\temp or C:\system\test.

atomics.note: Creates a Run key value that launches a payload.

chain.procedure: Installs AnyDesk as a service from several paths and logs in through Tor and Mullvad exit IPs. In 2024 it used the victim's own authorised remote-access tooling instead.

atomics.testName: AnyDesk Files Detected Test on Windows
atomics.note: Drops and runs AnyDesk.

chain.procedure: Runs NetScan (renamed netscan.exe or netapp.exe) for network enumeration, and AdFind for AD account and trust discovery.

atomics.note: Enumerates remote hosts with NetScan.

atomics.testName: Adfind - Enumerate Active Directory User Objects
atomics.note: Enumerates AD user objects with AdFind.
Enumerates AD trusts with AdFind.

chain.procedure: Dumps credentials with Mimikatz (mimikatz.log artifact) and Cobalt Strike to obtain domain-admin credentials.

atomics.note: Runs Mimikatz against LSASS.
In-memory PowerShell Mimikatz.

chain.procedure: With domain-admin access it joins ESXi hosts to AD through vCenter, then creates an AD group 'ESX Admins' and adds accounts to it. This exploits CVE-2024-37085 to get full ESXi admin. It also creates privileged domain accounts.

atomics.note: Creates and manipulates a domain group and its membership, the AD-side change behind CVE-2024-37085. Run it with the group name 'ESX Admins' for full fidelity.

atomics.testName: Create a new Domain Account using PowerShell
atomics.note: Creates a new domain account with PowerShell.

chain.procedure: Loads the vulnerable MSI Afterburner driver RTCore64.sys (CVE-2019-16098) through a service named RABAsSaa and zeroes kernel callbacks and ETW to blind more than 1,000 security drivers. 2024 builds drop four drivers (RtCore64.sys, DBUtil_2_3.sys, zamguard64.sys, gdrv.sys) with random 8-character names.

atomics.testName: Scattered Spider BYOVD (CVE-2015-2291 for Intel Ethernet Diagnostics Driver)
atomics.note: Loads a known-vulnerable signed driver (iqvw64e.sys) as a kernel service, the same BYOVD service-load pattern with a different driver.

atomics.testName: Kill antimalware protected processes using Backstab
atomics.note: Kills protected AV processes through a signed driver with Backstab.

chain.procedure: Disables Defender through the registry and adds a '*.exe' extension exclusion. It also stops the Defender service where tamper protection is off, uninstalls EDR on key hosts and disables Raccine.

atomics.testName: Tamper with Windows Defender Evade Scanning -Extension
atomics.note: Adds a Defender extension exclusion, like the '*.exe' exclusion.
Disables Defender through registry values.

chain.procedure: Sets LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy=1, EnableLinkedConnections=1 and LongPathsEnabled so remote execution and long-path encryption work across the network.

atomics.note: Applies the BlackByte registry changes from cmd.
Applies the BlackByte registry changes from PowerShell.

chain.procedure: Turns off Windows Firewall with netsh and enables the File and Printer Sharing and Network Discovery rule groups for remote discovery.

atomics.testName: Blackbit - Disable Windows Firewall using netsh firewall
atomics.note: Turns off the firewall with 'netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off'.

atomics.testName: Allow SMB and RDP on Microsoft Defender Firewall
atomics.note: Opens SMB and RDP through the firewall.

chain.procedure: Sets encrypted files and the ReadMe to 2000-01-01. The binary deletes itself with a ping delay, fsutil zeroing and del, and the 2024 build deletes taskmgr/perfmon/resmon.

atomics.note: Timestomps a file.
Removes indicators with fsutil, as in the self-delete routine.

chain.procedure: The wormable encryptor installs itself as a service and spreads over SMB/NTLM using victim credentials compiled into the binary. With -a, BlackByte 2.0 uses a UPX-packed PsExec to push itself to hosts.

atomics.testName: Copy and Execute File with PsExec
atomics.note: Copies a payload over an admin share and runs it with PsExec.

atomics.testName: Use PsExec to execute a command on a remote host
atomics.note: Runs a remote command with PsExec.

chain.techniqueName: Exfiltration Over Web Service: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
chain.procedure: ExByte, a Go tool sometimes disguised as explorer.exe or atieclxx.exe, catalogues target file extensions into a log, decrypts MEGA credentials from data.txt and uploads data through the MEGA API. Files have also been sent to anonymfiles/file.io.

atomics.testName: Exfiltrate data with rclone to cloud Storage - Mega (Windows)
atomics.note: Uploads to MEGA with rclone instead of ExByte. The destination is the same, so it exercises the MEGA egress analytics.

chain.procedure: For each drive, runs 'vssadmin resize shadowstorage /maxsize=401MB' then '/maxsize=unbounded' to purge shadow copies, and deletes shadow copies through WMI.

atomics.note: vssadmin resize shadowstorage.

atomics.testName: Windows - Delete Volume Shadow Copies via WMI
atomics.note: Shadow-copy deletion through WMI.

chain.procedure: Encrypts local, mapped and network-share data (extensions .blackbyte, later .blackbytent_h) and leaves a ransom note in every encrypted directory. It also 'print-bombs' the note with 'wordpad.exe /p' on connected printers.

atomics.note: Simulates BlackByte print-bombing of the ransom note.
Drops a ransom note artifact. The encryptor itself is not reproduced.
